description: This file contains an extension to the OnboardingView class, adding functionality to initiate a chat-based onboarding sequence by sending a predefined message to the user.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: A view responsible for onboarding users, extended here to include chat initiation logic.

methods.name: maybeKickoffOnboardingChat
methods.description: Triggers a chat message as part of onboarding if certain conditions are met, such as the current page index and whether the chat has already been auto-started.
